description: This bar chart illustrates the popularity scores for different large language models across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents the categories with labels “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity,” employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20.  Six distinct bars are present for each category, representing the models Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), ChatGPT (yellow), Acc=0 & GT Ans (dark grey, diagonal stripes), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (dark grey, vertical stripes), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (white). Within each category, the bars are grouped together by category. For “Movies”, the heights of the bars range approximately from 24 (ChatGPT) to 48 (Llama3). For “Songs”, the bars range from about 28 (Qwen2) to 84 (Llama3). The “Basketball” category contains the tallest bars, ranging from approximately 56 (ChatGPT) to 192 (Qwen2). No bars are explicitly emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
